questions.solution:
**Given:**

Nalini's younger brother is 12 years old 

Let Nalini Age be X

Ratio of their age = 7 : 6

**Calculation:**

X : 12 = 7: 6

X = 14

So Nalini's age is 14 years.

Now after 6 years, their ages will be

Nalini :14+ 6 = 20

Younger Brother: 12 + 6 = 18

So, ratio = 20 : 18

10: 9

**∴ The required ratio is 10: 9**

questions.question: 10 men or 15 women can complete a work in 30 days. In how many days can 15 men and 27 women complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

10 men or 15 women can complete a work in 30 days

**Calculation:**

Let the new time be x days

Now,

10M × 30 = 15W × 30

⇒ 300M = 450W

⇒ 2M = 3W

Total work = 10 × 30 = 300 units

Now 15M and 27W = 15M and 18M [Converted women into men]

So, time = 300/33 = 100/11 days or 9(1)/(11)days

**∴ The required time is 9(1)/(11)days**

questions.question: A person saves 25% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and his saving remains the same, then what will be the increased percentage of his expenditure?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let initial Income = 100, which means Savings = 25 and Expenditure = 75.

New Income = 120 (increased by 20%) and Savings = 25 (remains constant).

New Expenditure = 120 − 25 = 95.

Increase in Expenditure = 95 − 75 = 20.

Percentage Increase = (20 ÷ 75) × 100 = 26 ²/₃%.

**∴ The correct answer is 26 ²/₃%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A person saves 25% of his income.

Income increases by 20% while savings remain the same.

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Percentage Increase = (Increase in Value ÷ Original Value) × 100

 
 Initial Income = 100
 
 
 Exp = 75
 Sav = 25

 
 New Income = 120 (+20%)
 
 
 Exp = 95
 Sav = 25
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 + 20
 
 
 % Increase = (20 ÷ 75) × 100 ≈ 26.66%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial income be 100 units.

⇒ Initial saving = 25% of 100 = 25 units

⇒ Initial expenditure = 100 − 25 = 75 units

⇒ After a 20% increase, the new income = 100 + 20% of 100 = 120 units

⇒ New saving = 25 units (as it remains the same)

⇒ New expenditure = 120 − 25 = 95 units

⇒ Increase in expenditure = 95 − 75 = 20 units

⇒ Percentage increase in expenditure = (20 ÷ 75) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (4 ÷ 15) × 100 = 80 ÷ 3 = 26 ²/₃%

**∴ The correct answer is 26 ²/₃%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Concept

The foundational equation is **Income = Expenditure + Savings**. Any change in income will exactly equal the sum of changes in expenditure and savings.

Constant Variable Effect

If savings remain constant, the entire absolute increase in income directly translates to the absolute increase in expenditure.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage change is always calculated based on the initial value: % Change = [(Final − Initial) ÷ Initial] × 100.
</p

questions.question: What is the sum of all the possible values of k for which a seven-digit number 23k567k is divisible by 3?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A seven-digit number 23k567k is divisible by 3

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 3 → If the sum of all digits of a number is divisible by 3

**Calculation:**

2 + 3 + k + 5 + 6 + 7 + k = 23 + 2k

Now, 23 + 2k is divisible by 3

So, the Nearest numbers which is divisible by 3 = 24, 27, 30, 33, 36, 39

Now, 2k ≠ 1, 7, 13

k ≤ 9

So, possible values of 2k = 4, 10, 16

So, the sum of all the values of 2k = 30

So, k = 15

**∴ The required answer is 15**

If x⁶ - 6√6y⁶ = (x² + Ay²)(x⁴ + Bx²y² + Cy⁴), then what will be the value of (A² - B² + C²)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x⁶ - 6√6y⁶ = (x² + Ay²)(x⁴ + Bx²y² + Cy⁴)

**Concept used:**

x³ - y³ = (x - y)(x² + xy + y²)

**Calculation:**

x⁶ - 6√6y⁶ = (x² + Ay²)(x⁴ + Bx²y² + Cy⁴)

⇒ (x²)³ - (√6y²)³ = (x² + Ay²)(x⁴ + Bx²y² + Cy⁴)

⇒ (x² - √6y²)(x⁴ + x² × √6y² + 6y⁴) = (x² + Ay²)(x⁴ + Bx²y² + Cy⁴)

Comparing both sides of the equation we get-

A = -√6, B = √6, C = 6

So, (A² - B² + C²) = 6 - 6 + 6² = 36

**∴ The value of (A² - B² + C²) is 36.**

questions.question: There are 3 groups of persons - male, female and children. There are 20 males and the number of females and children taken together is 4 more than that of the males. The average weight of males is 54 kg, that of females is 49 kg and that of children is 30 kg. If the average weight of the whole group is 48.25 kg, then what is the difference between the number of females and the number of children?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No of males = 20

The number of females and children is 4 more than that of males.

The average weight of males is 54 kg

The average weight of females is 49 kg

The average weight of children is 30 kg

The average weight of the whole group is 48.25 kg

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of Observations/ Number of Observations

**Calculation:**

Number of Females + Children = 20 + 4 = 24

Let the number of females is x and the number of children be 24 – x

So total persons = 20 + 24 = 44

A/Q-

44 × 48.25 = 20 × 54 + 49 × x + (24 - x) × 30

⇒ 2123 = 1080 + 49x + 720 – 30x

⇒ 19x = 2123 – 1800

⇒ x = 17

So, Number of females = 17 and number of children = 24 - 17 = 7

The required difference is 17 - 7 = 10

**∴ The required difference is 10.**

questions.question: A solid metallic sphere of radius 10 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a solid metallic sphere = 10 cm

The radius of a smaller sphere = 2 cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of Sphere = 4/3πr³

**Calculation:**

Let the number of smaller spheres formed be n

⇒ 4/3 × π × 10³ = n × 4/3 × π × 2³

⇒ n = (10/2)³

⇒ n = 125

**∴ 125 such spheres can be formed.**

questions.question: Sunil can row a boat 20 km upstream in 1 hour and 15 minutes. If the speed of the current of the river is 2 km/h, then how much time will he take to row the boat 30 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Upstream speed** = 20 ÷ 1.25 = 16 km/h (Since 1 h 15 m = 1.25 h)

**Boat speed** in still water = Upstream speed + Current speed = 16 + 2 = 18 km/h

**Downstream speed** = Boat speed + Current speed = 18 + 2 = 20 km/h

**Time downstream** = Distance ÷ Downstream speed = 30 ÷ 20 = 1.5 hours

1.5 hours = 1 hour 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1 h 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Upstream Distance = 20 km

Upstream Time = 1 hour 15 minutes = 1 + 15/60 = 5/4 hours

Speed of Current (v) = 2 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Upstream Speed (U) = u − v

Downstream Speed (D) = u + v

(where u is the **speed of boat** in still water and v is the **speed of current**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6e4f62e394483a443d42e70ff8f21dd5e2f7b20c9e27d5d004699c21ac83bd9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Upstream speed (U) = 20 ÷ (5/4) = 20 × 4/5 = 16 km/h

⇒ u − v = 16

⇒ u − 2 = 16

⇒ u = 18 km/h (**Speed of Sunil in still water**)

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = u + v = 18 + 2 = 20 km/h

⇒ Time to row 30 km downstream = 30 ÷ 20 = 1.5 hours

⇒ 1.5 hours = 1 hour + (0.5 × 60) minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1 h 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of boat in still water (u)

It is the average of downstream and upstream speeds: u = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of current/stream (v)

It is half the difference between downstream and upstream speeds: v = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Time, Speed, and Distance relation

Time = Distance ÷ Speed. For constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time.</p
